myWork.label: My Work
myWork.summary: Your actions, drafts, reviews and deadlines in one place.
myWork.contents: Assigned actions, drafts, reviews, approvals, missing updates and upcoming deadlines.

executive.label: Executive Overview
executive.summary: The portfolio at a glance for executives.
executive.contents: Outcomes, value, critical initiatives, adoption, blockers and decisions.

transformations.label: Transformations
transformations.summary: The portfolio and each transformation's workspace.

playbook.label: Playbook and Procedures
playbook.summary: The methodology as searchable guidance and executable procedures.
playbook.contents: Searchable source, guidance and executable procedures.

strategy.label: Strategy and KPIs
strategy.contents: Outcome trees, definitions, targets, actuals and performance reviews.

tom.label: Target Operating Model
tom.summary: The target operating model and its gaps.
tom.contents: Canvas, gaps, capabilities, processes and design decisions.

initiatives.label: Initiatives and Roadmaps
initiatives.contents: Cases, prioritization, waves, resources, milestones and dependencies.

governance.label: Governance
governance.contents: Forums, meetings, decision rights, RACI, approvals and stage gates.

risks.label: Risks and Actions
risks.contents: Integrated RAID, corrective actions and escalations.

evidence.label: Evidence and Reports
evidence.contents: Native deliverables, attachments, snapshots and generated packs.

bau.label: BAU and Improvement
bau.summary: Handover to business as usual and continuous improvement.
bau.contents: Handovers, controls, lessons and improvement backlog.

admin.label: Administration
admin.contents: Methodology, forms, workflows, automation, organization, access and branding.

entry.title: Open the {{tab}} screen of a transformation
entry.body: This content is part of each transformation's workspace. Choose a transformation:
entry.portfolioPlanned: A cross-portfolio view of this area, with its records across all transformations, is planned for a later release. The dashboards under the Executive Overview summarize the transformations you can read.

p4.beingBuiltBody: This screen is part of the current release and is being built. It shows no data yet, and nothing here is available to use.

kpis.title: KPIs
kpis.summary: KPI dictionary, versions, targets and trajectories.

kpi.title: KPI
kpi.summary: One KPI: definition, versions, thresholds and status.

kpiActuals.title: KPI actuals
kpiActuals.summary: Enter, review and accept the actuals of a KPI per period.

benefit.title: Benefit
benefit.summary: One benefit: logic, owner, values and validation.

benefitOverlap.title: Benefit overlap
benefitOverlap.summary: A possible double count between two benefits, to be resolved.

financeValidation.title: Finance validation
financeValidation.summary: The Finance validation queue of benefit values.

actions.title: Actions
actions.summary: Actions from meetings, RAID and corrective cases.

correctiveActions.title: Corrective actions
correctiveActions.summary: Corrective and recovery cases with owners and follow-up dates.

forums.title: Forums
forums.summary: The governance forums and their meeting series.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.summary: One meeting: agenda, attendance, minutes and actions.

adoption.title: Adoption
adoption.summary: Stakeholder groups, interventions and adoption indicators.

changeRequest.title: Change request
changeRequest.summary: One change request: impact, routing and decision.

dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.summary: Executive, transformation, workstream, Finance, adoption and personal dashboards.

traceability.title: Traceability
traceability.summary: From strategy to value, with orphan records flagged.

landing.body: Each part of this area and where to find it. Parts that live in a transformation's workspace open from the list of transformations below.

studio.title: Playbook Studio
studio.summary: Configuration versions of the methodology: draft, preview and test, review, publish and rollback.

methodologyMigrations.title: Methodology migrations
methodologyMigrations.summary: Moving a transformation to a newer methodology version: plan, business approval and execution.

sourceCoverage.title: Source coverage
sourceCoverage.summary: The source-completeness check of the methodology: every playbook element set, counted.

formSchema.title: Form schema
formSchema.summary: The fields of one form in a configuration version.

methodologyCoverage.title: Methodology coverage
methodologyCoverage.summary: Each methodology element with the form or procedure that implements it.

automation.title: Automation
automation.summary: Versioned automation rules, dry runs, executions and the failure queue.

automationFailures.title: Automation failure queue
automationFailures.summary: Failed automation actions to review and retry.

approvalRoutes.title: Approval routes
approvalRoutes.summary: Sequential and parallel approval routes per procedure or record type.

notificationPreferences.title: Notification preferences
notificationPreferences.summary: Quiet hours, digests and urgent notifications.

p6.notAvailableBody: This screen is planned for this release and is not available yet. It shows no data, and nothing here can be used.

audit.title: Audit
audit.summary: The audit trail of the organizations and transformations you can read: who did what, when, and with which version. Read-only.

auditEvent.title: Audit event
auditEvent.summary: One audit event: actor, action, time, record and versions.

security.title: Security
security.summary: The upload policy and the rate-limit classes of your organization.

uploadPolicy.title: Upload policy
uploadPolicy.summary: The file types and the size limit allowed for evidence uploads.

sensitiveGrants.title: Sensitive grants
sensitiveGrants.summary: Explicit access to sensitive benefits, business cases and evidence: grant and revoke, with a reason.

sensitiveGrant.title: Sensitive grant
sensitiveGrant.summary: One grant: the record, the person, the reason and its status.

deepLink.title: Opening a link
deepLink.summary: A link from a notification. Your access is checked again before the item opens.

operations.title: Operations
operations.summary: Operational exceptions, the worker heartbeat and the service identities of jobs and connectors.

operationalException.title: Operational exception
operationalException.summary: One operational exception: its occurrences, linked KPIs, acknowledgement and resolution.

serviceIdentities.title: Service identities
serviceIdentities.summary: The constrained identity of every job and connector, and the permissions it is granted.

serviceIdentity.title: Service identity
serviceIdentity.summary: One service identity: what it declares and what it is granted.

identity.title: Identity
identity.summary: The sign-in settings: issuer, audience and client. The client secret is never shown.

storage.title: Storage
storage.summary: Where evidence files are stored, with credential references, never the secrets.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.summary: The notification channels: in-app always, email when configured, and the delivery log.

notificationChannel.title: Notification channel
notificationChannel.summary: One channel's settings, with credential references, never the secrets.

notificationDeliveries.title: Notification deliveries
notificationDeliveries.summary: Each delivery's status, attempts and error code, never its text or address.
